FROM (SELECT ESTNR, SPB, MIN(BUDAT) AS d, MAX(WB_QTY_TOTAL) AS w FROM FDN WHERE ESTNR = 'EC' AND BUDAT >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AND BUDAT < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) GROUP BY ESTNR, SPB) t
JOIN EST e ON e.ESTNR = t.ESTNR AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
WHERE t.w > 0
GROUP BY e.NAME1, YEAR(t.d), MONTH(t.d)
ORDER BY estate, year, month

-- Bunches per mature ha
SELECT TOP 100 e.NAME1 AS estate, YEAR(h.month) AS year, MONTH(h.month) AS month, h.bunches, a.ha, h.bunches / NULLIF(a.ha, 0) AS bunches_per_ha
FROM (
    SELECT WERKS, BUDAT AS month, SUM(CAST(ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) AS bunches
    FROM OPH
    WHERE WERKS = '00EC' AND BUDAT >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AND BUDAT < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
    GROUP BY WERKS, BUDAT
) h
JOIN (
    SELECT ESTNR, SUM(BHA) AS ha
    FROM BLK
    WHERE ESTNR = 'EC' AND KDATE = '9999-12-31' AND BSTATE = 'MATURE'
    GROUP BY ESTNR
) a ON a.ESTNR = RIGHT(h.WERKS, 2)
JOIN EST e ON e.WERKS = h.WERKS AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
ORDER BY year, month

-- Bunches per harvester-day
WITH period AS (
    SELECT DATEADD(month, -12, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)) AS period_start, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) AS period_end
)
SELECT TOP 100 e.NAME1 AS estate, YEAR(o.BUDAT) AS year, MONTH(o.BUDAT) AS month,
       AVG(d.bunches) AS bunches_per_harvester_day
FROM OPH o
JOIN EST e ON e.WERKS = o.WERKS AND e.KDATE = '9999-12-31'
CROSS JOIN period p
JOIN (
    SELECT WERKS, EMPNR, BUDAT, SUM(CAST(ZMASAK AS decimal(18,2))) AS bunches
    FROM OPH
    WHERE WERKS = '00EC'
      AND BUDAT >= p.period_start
      AND BUDAT < p.period_end
    GROUP BY WERKS, EMPNR, BUDAT
) d ON d.WERKS = o.WERKS AND d.EMPNR = o.EMPNR AND d.BUDAT = o.BUDAT
WHERE o.WERKS = '00EC'
GROUP BY e.NAME1, YEAR(o.BUDAT), MONTH(o.BUDAT)
ORDER BY e.NAME1, year, month
